purpose: Additional out-of-corpus (unanswerable) queries for evaluating abstention.
why_separate: evaluation/test_queries.json is frozen: it is the test set the saved retrieval metrics in retrieval_experiments.json were measured on, and changing it would invalidate them. Abstention evaluation needs many more negatives than the 5 that set contains, so extra negatives live here. Ranking metrics never use out-of-corpus queries, so this file does not affect them either way.
labelling: Every query below is answerable by NO section of the IPC or BNS. They span adjacent legal domains (tax, family, labour, procedure) as well as clearly unrelated topics, because near-domain queries are the harder case: they share vocabulary with criminal statutes without being covered by them.
